reviewed_objections.required_action: Address delivery quality failure using existing evidence; do not invent missing facts.
reviewed_objections.message: 内容空洞：多个部分（同行对比、估值敏感性、投资结论）仅陈述数据缺口，无实质性分析，缺乏投资洞察。; 权威/一手来源占比偏低：0.17; 权威一手来源占比偏低（0.17），依赖市场数据而非官方财报。; 图表为内部指标（关键指标、置信度、来源结构），不直接有助于公司基本面分析。
required_fixes: Add peer comparison metrics and explicit boundaries instead of framework-only text.
Rewrite hollow sections with evidence-backed business implications, investment judgment, and risk boundaries.
Investment conclusion must include direction, reasons, cited evidence, and risk constraints.
Prioritize fatal/blocker issues from the LLM review before final delivery.

valuation_analysis.impact_on_report: Valuation section must list missing inputs and avoid target-price style conclusions.

findings: TSLA 的主要风险包括三类：第一，行业竞争和供给扩张可能压缩高毛利业务的持续性；第二，宏观利率、资本开支周期和云厂商采购节奏会放大收入波动；第三，当前核心季度三表采用结构化降级来源，若后续一手公告与该数据不一致，盈利质量、自由现金流和估值结论都需要重算。
risk_analysis.impact_on_report: Risk section can cite identified operational or market risk evidence.

rejected_claims.claim_text: TSLA 2026Q1 敏感性分析显示，当前净利率约为 2.1%；若净利率变动 1pct，净利润方向性影响约为 223.87M。对科技公司应重点跟踪收入增速、毛利率和研发费用率；对消费品公司应重点跟踪收入增速、净利率和渠道价格。
